lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting horizontal spot rows, creating a grid of anchor nodes on the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel horizontal ridges visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from light on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple remoras (Echeneidae) clustered near the ventral surface and pectoral fin.
